options: A set of Microsoft datacenters within a defined latency perimeter, connected by a dedicated low-latency network
A single physical datacenter building
A synonym for an Azure subscription
A billing category used only for invoicing
questions.explain: A region groups multiple datacenters together with a dedicated low-latency network, and affects which services are available and how far resources are from users.

questions.q: Which Azure CLI command lists the regions available to your subscription?
options: az account list-locations
az group list
az account show
az policy definition list
questions.explain: az account list-locations returns every region available to the subscription, with both its display name and internal name like eastus.

questions.q: What is a paired region used for?
options: Sequencing planned platform updates and prioritizing disaster recovery between two matched regions in the same geography
Combining two subscriptions into one billing account
Automatically translating resource names between regions
Doubling the storage quota available to a subscription
questions.explain: Microsoft sequences updates across paired regions rather than rolling them out to both simultaneously, and documents replicating to your region's pair as the supported disaster recovery pattern.

questions.q: In the resource name rg-prod-eastus-web01, what does the eastus segment represent?
options: The instance number of the resource
The Azure region the resource is associated with
The environment, such as production or test
The resource type
questions.explain: Following the naming convention, eastus identifies the region, while rg identifies the resource type, prod the environment, and web01 the workload and instance.

questions.q: Why can't a storage account name follow the exact same hyphenated pattern as a resource group name like rg-prod-eastus-web01?
options: Storage account names must always match the subscription ID
Storage accounts cannot be named at all - Azure assigns a random ID
Storage account names must be lowercase alphanumeric only, 3 to 24 characters, with no hyphens allowed
Hyphens are reserved exclusively for virtual machine names
questions.explain: Storage account naming rules are stricter than most resource types, so the same convention compresses into a name like stprodeastusweb001 instead.
